content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Virginia Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously with a certified instructor and fellow Virginia Beach professionals. Upon completion, you'll receive your official training certificate—the proof of contact hours PMI requires for your application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Include your training certificate, project experience documentation, and payment for the PMI exam fee. PMI will audit and approve your application before you're eligible to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at an approved Pearson VUE testing center in the Virginia Beach area. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Renew your credential and membership fee before expiration to keep your PMP active and recognized.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
